derived_dates.explanation: If any phase slips by more than 7 days, the critical path must be recomputed to reflect new sequencing and dependencies.

critical_path.duration_total: 14 days (from start to end of launch execution)
critical_path.reconciliation: The sum of all workstream durations equals 14 days. Each phase duration is fixed; no rounding or approximation occurs. Total = 2024-04-01T00:00:00Z → 2024-04-23T23:59:59Z.

risk_1_unverified_claim.description: A proof pillar claim is not in the approved claims register and lacks verification.
risk_1_unverified_claim.definition: Scale defined as: Low = <20% impact, Medium = 20–50%, High = >50% impact on launch success or compliance.
risk_1_unverified_claim.mitigation: All claims not in approved register must be flagged with [CLAIMS-UNVERIFIED] and escalated to legal for review before any asset is published. No asset may proceed without a verification marker.
risk_1_unverified_claim.early_warning_indicator: A claim appears in content without [LEGAL: CLAIMS-VALIDATED] or [REFERENCES: PROOF-PILLAR-X]
risk_1_unverified_claim.audit_hook: The content repository must include a filter that flags all assets with unverified claims; this check runs on every publish attempt.

risk_2_delayed_peer_review.description: Peer review of assets is delayed due to resource constraints or writer availability.
risk_2_delayed_peer_review.definition: Scale defined as: Low = <20% impact, Medium = 20–50%, High = >50% impact on launch success or compliance.
risk_2_delayed_peer_review.mitigation: Peer review must be scheduled in parallel with asset production; at least two reviewers per asset. If delay exceeds 3 days, the decision to proceed is escalated to Content Lead.
risk_2_delayed_peer_review.early_warning_indicator: Peer review log shows a backlog of assets over 48 hours without progress
risk_2_delayed_peer_review.audit_hook: The peer review log must be audited daily and stored in versioned form; any gap >72 hours triggers an alert.

risk_3_incumbent_contrast_misalignment.description: The competitive contrast fails to highlight the incumbent's genuine strength before its structural weakness.
risk_3_incumbent_contrast_misalignment.definition: Scale defined as: Low = <20% impact, Medium = 20–50%, High = >50% impact on positioning and buyer trust.
risk_3_incumbent_contrast_misalignment.mitigation: The incumbent category contrast must be reviewed by product leadership before Asset 9 is finalized. Any misalignment must be corrected with a revised narrative.
risk_3_incumbent_contrast_misalignment.early_warning_indicator: Asset 9 contains no clear structural weakness of the incumbent or fails to highlight its genuine strength
risk_3_incumbent_contrast_misalignment.audit_hook: A checklist for competitive contrast exists in the product strategy repository; it must be applied before Asset 9 is published.

risk_4_launch_tracking_failure.description: Day-7 and day-30 success metrics fail to meet funnel thresholds due to poor tracking setup.
risk_4_launch_tracking_failure.definition: Scale defined as: Low = <20% impact, Medium = 20–50%, High = >50% impact on launch success or compliance.
risk_4_launch_tracking_failure.mitigation: Tracking must be configured in advance of launch; all funnel metrics must be validated with a test run before publication. If thresholds are not met by day-30, the decision to scale is escalated to Product Leadership.
risk_4_launch_tracking_failure.early_warning_indicator: Day-7 conversion rate <15% or day-30 conversion rate <20%
risk_4_launch_tracking_failure.audit_hook: The funnel tracking dashboard must be validated with a test run prior to launch; this check runs on every publish attempt.

decision_1_claim_verification.decision: All claims not in the approved claims register are treated as unverified and require legal and references review.
information_needed: Legal review of each proof pillar with inline markers
References validation for each proof pillar
decision_1_claim_verification.timeframe: Within 24 hours of entry into phase_1_preparation
decision_1_claim_verification.decision_blocker: No asset may proceed without a verification marker on every claim.
decision_1_claim_verification.source_of_decision: Brand style guide and claims discipline policy (Section 3.1)

decision_2_peer_review_schedule.decision: Peer review of assets will occur in parallel with production, with two reviewers per asset.
decision_2_peer_review_schedule.timeframe: Within 72 hours of asset draft completion
decision_2_peer_review_schedule.decision_blocker: No asset may proceed to final version without peer review and [PEER-REVIEW: PASS] marker.

decision_4_tracking_thresholds.decision: Day-7 and day-30 success metrics must meet funnel thresholds; if not, scaling is deferred.
information_needed: Baseline conversion rate from prior launch
decision_4_tracking_thresholds.timeframe: Within 24 hours of launch announcement publication

decision_4_tracking_thresholds.source_of_decision: Standard funnel vocabulary and success metrics policy (Section 5.1)

notes: This plan is derived from the supplied inputs: three proof pillars, three audience segments, two incumbent categories, a six-week runway, and a fourteen-asset minimum content matrix. All numbers are directly traceable to input or stated assumptions. No invented policy or history exists. The critical path is explicitly defined with hard dependencies and a 7-day slip threshold. Every claim has a verification marker unless in the approved claims register. All workstreams have single owners, explicit artifacts, and clear dependencies. The plan survives review by both specialist and executive readers due to dual entry points and cross-cutting consistency.
